title: Quality + momentum sleeve
hypothesis: Splitting the momentum sleeve between momentum and quality (profitability) raises risk-adjusted returns because quality hedges momentum crashes.
rationale: Quality/profitability tends to hold up in momentum crashes and junk rallies; RMW still significant post-2010.
data: Ken French Data Library: F-F_Research_Data_Factors, 6_Portfolios_ME_Prior_12_2, 6_Portfolios_ME_OP_2x3, Developed_3_Factors, Developed_6_Portfolios_ME_Prior_12_2, Developed_6_Portfolios_ME_OP (USD, to 2026-08)
Yahoo ^NDX / QQQ daily (live champion, via h03_leveraged_trend.py)
Yahoo adjusted closes VWRL.L, IWFM.L, IWFQ.L, LQQ3.L 2014-11..2026-08 for the tradeable check
methodology: Pre-registered grid Q1 50/25/25, Q2 0/50/50, Q3 34/33/33 (MKT/MOM/QUAL) + 4 neighbours; pick by in-sample Sharpe; Stage 2 vs the live champion (US) and vs the previous champion (US, Developed).
benchmark: Gate: live champion nasdaq3x_trend_sma100_v1 (synthetic 3x Nasdaq-100 + SMA100, monthly). Information: previous champion 50% MKT + 50% MOM.
costs: OCF MKT 0.22%, MOM 0.30%, QUAL 0.25% p.a.; one-way MKT 0.10%, MOM 0.35%, QUAL 0.20%; stress x3
robustness: deflated Sharpe with cumulative trial count
tradeable GBP ETF check with same-day and next-day execution
limitations: USD academic portfolios; the live champion is also in USD here, the real fund is GBX
BIG HiOP (operating profitability) is a proxy for MSCI World Quality (ROE, leverage, earnings variability)
The live champion was installed by owner override (E009), not via the gate; comparing an unlevered portfolio against a 3x strategy mostly measures leverage, not the quality effect
decision_detail: Failed Stage 2 vs the live champion (US OOS): costs_x3, dsr_ge_0_90, neighbours, oos_beats. Vs the previous champion 50/50 (both markets): fails dsr_ge_0_90.
